crime_highlights: The offender, along with two associates, Smith and Cappello, planned to carry out a home invasion and robbery at the residence of a rival drug dealer
In addition, they had two loaded handguns in a duffle bag
I accepted that the offender handled one of the firearms and put it in the pouch of his hoodie while he was in the vehicle
he disguised himself by tying a light coloured slitted tank top around his face and pulling up his hoodie
rationale_highlights: The only mitigating factor is Upton's terribly disadvantaged Aboriginal and personal background as a child and youth.
While it must have had very serious long-term effects upon him, the aggravating factors far outweigh the mitigating ones.
By age 13, Upton had lived in 17 different foster homes.
note: Court treats background as only mitigating factor but outweighed by aggravating factors.

crime_highlights: On May 5, 2014, Dakota Johnny was convicted of the manslaughter of Cindy Scow.
she was brutally beaten, likely with a dowel, about the head and body
She was left to die alone in these circumstances after Mr. Johnny left the scene.
she succumbed, and she was pronounced dead in the early morning hours on September 10, 2012
Mr. Johnny did not leave to seek immediate help for her
rationale_highlights: Mr. Johnny's mother is a survivor of the St. Michael's Indian Residential School
As a consequence of his parents' struggle with alcohol and substance abuse, he left the reserve at age 15
I am mindful of his background, as I have set out in detail in reference to the Gladue report, and of his family and present situations.
note: Court says only it is mindful of background; no explicit effect on sentence stated.

crime_highlights: the accused put his hand over her mouth and told her to shut up
he told her that if she ever told her aunty, he would hurt her
the accused told her to be quiet and on many occasions that her mom was not to be told
She went on to describe herself as being confused, because she was only eight or nine years old
rationale_highlights: Crown has identified, in their view, the only mitigating factor which is the aboriginal heritage of E.J.T.M.
I am satisfied that a fit sentence would be the sentence as proposed in the joint submission
note: Court notes Aboriginal heritage as mitigating but never explains effect; joint submission accepted.
